test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can do a piece of work in 10 days, while A and B together can complete it in 2(1)/(2) days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete the work in 2(1)/(2) days.

A alone can complete the work in 10 days.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A each day = (1)/(10)

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ (1)/(10)+(1)/(B)=(2)/(5)

⇒ (1)/(B)=(2)/(5)-(1)/(10)

⇒ (1)/(B)=(4-1)/(10) = (3)/(10)

⇒ B = (10)/(3)

**Therefore, B alone will take (10)/(3) days to complete the work.**
